name: Perturbation and Error Dynamics Law
purpose: Define how perturbations propagate through constrained continuation systems.

candidate_law_statement.informal: Perturbations modify continuation structure by altering admissibility margins, transport pathways, reinforcement stability, and reconstruction accessibility.

formal.propagation_condition: Perturbations may propagate when accessibility relations and transport conditions permit admissibility-compatible continuation transfer.
formal.amplification_condition: Amplify(P_Δ) may occur when perturbation reinforcement exceeds local stabilization tolerance.
formal.damping_condition: Damp(P_Δ) may occur when stabilization basins absorb perturbation within bounded admissibility margin.
formal.cascade_condition: Cascade(P_Δ) may occur when perturbation-induced budget depletion triggers recursive destabilization across connected continuation channels.
formal.corruption_condition: Corrupt(P_Δ) may alter reconstruction accessibility, reinforcement history continuity, or identity persistence beyond declared tolerance.
formal.resilience_clause: Stabilization resilience depends on reinforcement depth, accessibility redundancy, admissibility margin reserve, and topology connectivity.
